notes.title: Another small fix
notes.notes: Now allowed to press Escape to close the examine item view.

notes.title: Small Bug Fix
notes.notes:
There was a bug where if you're playing on a file with play time, then return to the title and click new game, if you were to save on that new file, it would carry over the playtime from the initial file. This is now fixed.

That is all.

notes.title: Finishing touches
notes.notes: I feel like the game is in its most ideal state now. I can't find anything else to fix. Now I'll just wait and respond to any issues that players bring up.

notes.title: Some Changes
notes.notes: Improved some visuals, and added a couple subtle helpful light sources in certain spots of the map.

notes.title: Performance improvements
notes.notes: Game runs a little bit better.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Fixed more missing sounds, and texture mistakes.

notes.title: Another Quick Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed some errors where sounds weren't being played.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: There was a piece of environment that was meant to be disabled but wasn't. It has now been removed.
